say: Lewis Hall is likely off to Manchester United. So how do you replace him?
cap: LEWIS HALL IS LIKELY OFF TO MANCHESTER UNITED. SO HOW DO YOU REPLACE HIM?

say: Over the last two seasons, among Premier League full-backs, he's first for ball recoveries and blocked shots, and fourth for dribbles. But only thirty-fourth for assists.
cap: OVER THE LAST TWO SEASONS, AMONG PREMIER LEAGUE FULL-BACKS, HE'S FIRST FOR BALL RECOVERIES AND BLOCKED SHOTS, AND FOURTH FOR DRIBBLES. BUT ONLY THIRTY-FOURTH FOR ASSISTS.

say: So we compared him with all 140 left-backs in Europe's top five leagues.
cap: SO WE COMPARED HIM WITH ALL 140|140 LEFT-BACKS IN EUROPE'S TOP FIVE LEAGUES.

say: The two closest: Nuno Tavares and Javi Galán.
cap: THE TWO CLOSEST: NUNO TAVARES AND JAVI GALÁN.

say: But Tavares is twenty-six, and Galán is thirty-one.
cap: BUT TAVARES IS 26|twenty-six, AND GALÁN IS 31|thirty-one.

say: Hall is only twenty-two. So: twenty-three and under only.
cap: HALL IS ONLY 22|twenty-two. SO: 23|twenty-three AND UNDER ONLY.

say: And number one is Kaiki, from Como.
cap: AND NUMBER ONE IS KAIKI, FROM COMO.

say: He's twenty-three, and worth fifteen million euros. A quarter of Hall's price.
cap: HE'S 23|twenty-three, AND WORTH €15M|fifteen-million-euros. A QUARTER OF HALL'S PRICE.

cap: HALL AGAINST KAIKI, ON WHAT MAKES HALL SPECIAL: DRIBBLES, BALL RECOVERIES, BLOCKED SHOTS AND LONG BALLS.

cap: AND KAIKI CREATES MORE CHANCES, AND DRIBBLES EVEN MORE. EARLY DAYS THOUGH: ONLY FIVE GAMES' WORTH OF MINUTES.
